description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.60 each), restores HP (85) to all allies, grants [Last Stand] to all allies, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Awoken Holy] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Awoken Holy
description.text: Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
